== Old ==
The core of [[Lifeism]] is the three covenants which correspond to the [[Three Fruits]]

# [[Omega covenant|Omega Covenant]] which revolves around [[immortality]], and [[mirroring]]
# [[Lambda Covenant]] which revolves around [[nobility]] and the [[ninefold vaccine]]
# [[Alpha covenant|Alpha Covenant]] which revolves around [[childrearing]], [[apotheosis]] and [[cosmic victory]]


The three covenants are structured in the [[ola]] structure.

The covenants are meant to act as an [[Ecology of Practices]]
